answer: Each agent posts a 200 POA bond into escrow, its sponsor link on a quartz-clear referral graph, mooring each identity at a wharf. An agent wandering between sponsors to hide its origin is flagged, since the graph shows the path. A dispute makes both sides stake 50 POA: a false claim costs the challenger, a proven fake loses the bond and slashes the sponsor. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 POA; one honest agent pays once and keeps its reward.
